remarks:
This is the Ellicottville location you've been looking for! Ideally situated directly across Holiday Valley Road from the slopes, this nicely updated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse puts skiing, recreation and all the fun of Ellicottville right outside your door. Walk across the road to the Sunrise Chairlift or Main Lodge, or take a healthy stroll into the Village for restaurants, shopping, nightlife and après-ski.

A true four-season destination, this is a fantastic spot for enjoying everything Ellicottville has to offer. Ski and snowboard all winter, then trade the slopes for golf, hiking, mountain biking and other outdoor adventures when the weather warms up. Use it as your own weekend getaway, a year-round retreat, or take advantage of the strong vacation rental appeal when you're not enjoying it yourself.

The townhouse has been nicely updated with a new gas fireplace, new hot water tank and mini-split system to keep things comfortable on warm summer nights. The 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath layout offers plenty of space for family and friends, with an inviting living area that is perfect for relaxing after a day outdoors.

Short-term rentals are permitted, and some permits are still available, creating an attractive opportunity for those looking to generate rental income while owning their own piece of Ellicottville. With the slopes across the street and the Village within walking distance, this is a prime location for experiencing the best of Ellicottville in every season.

The association currently has an annual special assessment, in addition to the association dues, which should go through 2028 - see the attached Homeowners' Association Rider.
